title: Adaptive Control of Scientific Instruments with Nonstationary Responses through Multimodal Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.32370v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Controlling scientific instruments requires parameters to be adjusted progressively in response to feedback from successive operations. When unobserved operating conditions evolve with operational history, responses become nonstationary, and a static mapping from actions to responses becomes inadequate for decisions across shots. Shot-to-shot tuning of neutral beam injection (NBI) ion sources in magnetic confinement fusion devices is representative of this class of problems: the conditions of electrode surfaces and vacuum are difficult to observe directly, discharge outcomes vary between shots, and experiments are costly and carry operational risks. We propose a physically grounded multimodal agent with three independently auditable components. translated_title: 基于多模态智能体的非平稳响应科学仪器自适应控制
translated_abstract: 控制科学仪器需要根据连续操作反馈逐步调整参数。当未被观测的运行条件随操作历史演变时，系统响应呈现非平稳性，此时从动作到响应的静态映射已无法支撑跨炮次的决策。磁约束聚变装置中中性束注入（NBI）离子源的逐炮调谐是这类问题的典型代表：电极表面与真空状态难以直接观测，放电结果在不同炮次之间存在差异，且实验成本高昂并带有运行风险。我们提出一种具有物理基础的多模态智能体，它包含三个可独立审计的组件：确定性算法从多通道波形中提取符号化物理量与视觉证据；一个双层记忆结构组织当前任务的轨迹和历史经验……
tldr: 本文提出一种具有物理基础、组件可独立审计的多模态智能体，通过确定性物理量提取与双层记忆机制，实现对响应非平稳的科学仪器（如磁约束聚变装置NBI离子源）的自适应逐炮调谐控制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a physically grounded multimodal agent with independently auditable components that adaptively tunes scientific instruments with nonstationary responses, demonstrated on shot-to-shot control of NBI ion sources in magnetic confinement fusion devices.
